subject: Automation scripts + Azure publisher identity checks for CloudFox listing
messages:
From: Ethan Jacobs <ejacobs@cloudfox.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: SaaSOps Partner Team <saasops@cloudfox.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure listing - automation scripts + identity checks

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We are ready to start the offer creation but want to automate as much of the plumbing as possible (manifest generation, SKU mapping, and tenant proof artifacts). Two asks: 1) do you have any example scripts or CI snippets you recommend for automating manifest JSON and publishing steps, and 2) what exact identity proof docs (service principal, publisher tenant confirmations) does Azure want for a first-pass validation?

Goal: get a staging offer into the publisher sandbox next week so the engineering team can run smoke tests.

Attached: none in this message — will send tenant evidence once we have guidance.

Cheers,
Ethan Jacobs
Product Ops Manager, CloudFox
E: ejacobs@cloudfox.com | M: +1 415-555-0142

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Jacobs <ejacobs@cloudfox.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure listing - automation scripts + identity checks

Ethan — great to hear you're moving forward.

Short answers up front: we have a small repo of helper scripts for manifest + SKU templating and a checklist for identity proofs. I'm attaching the checklist and a starter script (bash + jq) that our partner onboarding team uses.

Kimberly, can you confirm the minimal identity artifacts we should ask CloudFox to provide for the sandbox bootstrap? Also Vivek, FYI on co-sell evidence timeline — we'll probably need tenant claims and a short security statement to satisfy the co-sell intake.

Next steps for CloudFox: 1) run the attached listing-automation-scripts-v1.sh in a staging environment, 2) collect the tenant evidence JSON and the service principal cert, 3) drop both into the shared Drive link and ping us. We'll intake and hand to Azure if everything looks good.

Marissa Cole
Partner Lead, Marketplace Enablement
Redwood Inference

Attachments: listing-automation-scripts-v1.sh (shell script), azure_identity-proofchecklist.pdf (checklist)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ethan Jacobs <ejacobs@cloudfox.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure listing - automation scripts + identity checks

Ethan — adding a little more color on the identity side. Minimal items we require for a staging validation: 

- Publisher tenant ID (GUID) and confirmation that you control it (Azure portal screenshot OR tenant-owner email).
- Service principal client ID + app display name (do NOT send client secrets over email). We only need the metadata to validate SP existence.
- A sample tenant-evidence.json (format in attached sample) that lists subscription IDs used for testing and the sample endpoint we will hit for smoke tests.
- A short security statement (1 paragraph) describing where customer data is processed and retention policy for telemetry (this is used for co-sell paperwork).

I've attached tenant-evidence-sample.json and the checklist includes the portal screenshots we ask for. On the automation side, recommended approach: export manifest from your build pipeline as a templated JSON, run our validation script (manifest-lint in the repo), then call the Azure publisher API via the automation script. The attached shell script shows the CI flow; feel free to convert to PowerShell or GitHub Actions.

If you want, we can schedule a 30-min technical scrub with our infra engineer to walk the script and run it against your sandbox. Available windows: Thu 16 Jul 10:00-12:00 or Fri 17 Jul 13:00-15:00 PT.

—Kimberly
Head of Marketplace Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: tenant-evidence-sample.json (sample), azure_identity-proofchecklist.pdf (reference)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Jacobs <ejacobs@cloudfox.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure listing - automation scripts + identity checks

Ethan — quick note on incentives and timeline. For co-sell eligibility we'll need the identity proofs and a security statement in place before we register the offer for co-sell. That typically adds 3-5 business days for internal intake (validation + legal sign-off) once artifacts are complete. If you can hit the Thu window Kimberly mentioned and provide the tenant-evidence.json and portal screenshot, we can aim to submit to Azure the following week and pursue FastTrack co-sell.

Also: when you run the automation script, set the manifest versioning to follow semantic tags (v1.0.0) so we can pin an offer version during the canary. Small thing but helps rollbacks.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, North America
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Jacobs <ejacobs@cloudfox.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Jul 2025 16:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure listing - automation scripts + identity checks

Ethan — thanks for the quick follow. I'm copying a short checklist you can use to validate locally before we run the scrub: 

1) Run listing-automation-scripts-v1.sh against a staging manifest and confirm exit code 0.
2) Upload tenant-evidence.json and portal screenshot to the shared Drive link.
3) Paste the service principal app ID into the verification doc (DO NOT paste secrets).
4) Add the one-paragraph security statement to the metadata field in the manifest under "security_overview".
5) Reply in this thread with the Drive link; we'll queue the scrub and lock a time.

If all good, I'll create the HubSpot task and attach the DocuSign for the co-sell paperwork so legal can start the intake.

Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment references in thread: azure_identity-proofchecklist.pdf, listing-automation-scripts-v1.sh, tenant-evidence-sample.json
